topic_thesis: Your salary is flat, but corporate India is silently stealing 10-13% of your purchasing power through back-to-back price hikes.
strategic_angle: We expose the 'Margin Protection' scam: Companies aren't just adjusting for inflation; they are using it as a cover to hike prices by 13% cumulative while keeping your lifestyle costs artificially inflated to pad their own quarterly balance sheets.
key_statistic: 13% total price inflation in 6 months vs 0% salary growth for the average retail consumer.
target_emotion: Indignation and a sense of financial betrayal.
pinned_comment_text: Is your monthly budget bleeding because of these 'hidden' hikes? Tell us which brand you've noticed overcharging the most, or comment 'GUIDE' to get our manual on how to cut your cost-of-living overheads! 💸👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Use a tone of 'Middle-class makkale, ungalai epdi yemaathuranga parunga.' Focus on the 'Price hike' vs 'Salary hike' reality. Use Tanglish terms like 'Budget gaali', 'Corporate loot', and 'Vilai vaasi kooduthu, ana salary adhe than'.
source_signal: Consumer purchasing power erosion and the disconnect between corporate margin growth vs retail income stagnation.
